summary: RW (amendment 2026-11-28 item 1, genuinely learned rewards). Audit: the mix stayed 1 because the promotion test compared single policy steps (power ~0 at realistic rates), existed only at applied meta-updates, and the outer estimator used only the 3-4 decisions between two live updates; defect: level readings were stored as the level. Changed (reward/): prospective anytime-valid validity evidence decides the mix (no margin, no held-out reservation); pooled first-order outer estimator ('auto'); outer utility 'direct'; level readings as changes. Debug scale, one long LabWorld objective per seed vs a frozen R_psi (same seeds): learning raised R_psi's prospective agreement with verified outcomes in 12/12 seed-configurations; the evidence promoted R_psi in 2/3 600-decision objectives (never a frozen one), decisions changed 9-17 decisions later, chosen-action true value +2.06 [1.58, 2.54] adopters/decision afterwards in one seed (+2.05 [-0.92, 5.08] in the other, 27 decisions); 1/3 within 300 decisions; 0/3 at the agent's reward lr 1e-4. Real model: see real_* evidence and docs/RW.md section 5. Not shown: reliable improvement; promotion inside one GPU hold.
